description: a cylinder r 4, h 12 on the −x axis, its seam written, whose two circles are placed on the axis (−1, −6.12323399574e−17, −0) with no reference direction, as NIST's CTC-04 and FTC-08 write them: ISO 10303-42's first_proj_axis supplies world Y as the reference direction, the axis lying along world X to rounding, and the reader takes it so.
